description: This Java interface, ScopedConfig, extends Config and WithConfigPath, providing a specialized configuration object that maintains knowledge of its configuration path within a nested config structure. It offers methods to retrieve durations and integers from the configuration with validation that enforces non-negativity and positivity respectively, throwing DittoConfigError on invalid values. The interface includes documentation and constants related to configuring nested paths within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: getNonNegativeDurationOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a Duration at the specified config path, ensuring it is non-negative. Throws DittoConfigError if the duration is negative.

methods.name: getPositiveIntOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves an integer at the specified config path, ensuring it is positive. Throws DittoConfigError if the value is zero or negative.
